title: Achieving Simultaneous Buffering and Steiner Tree Synthesis via Harmonic Based Reinforcement Learning
problem: Buffer insertion and Steiner tree construction are traditionally separate tasks, but they are interdependent; joint optimization is computationally complex.
motivation: Simultaneous optimization of tree topology and buffer placement can yield superior circuit delay characteristics.
method: Reinforcement learning approach with harmonic function optimization to jointly construct Steiner trees and perform buffer insertion.
key_novelty: First RL-based approach with harmonic objective function for simultaneous Steiner tree and buffer insertion.
contributions: Novel reinforcement learning framework for joint tree and buffer optimization
Harmonic function formulation for optimization objective
Experimental validation of efficiency and effectiveness
Solution to interdependence problem between topology and buffer placement

metrics.ppa: Improved delay reduction through joint optimization
metrics.other: Efficiency and effectiveness demonstrated in experiments

limitations: RL training complexity and convergence not discussed; scalability to large circuits unclear.
primary_theme: RL for joint buffer and tree optimization
